caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular lid and four legs. The overall color of the chest is brown with carved decorative patterns highlighted in a lighter, yellowish-gold tone. The front panel of the chest is divided into three square sections at the top, each with intricate floral designs; the center square contains the initials "MB" in capital letters beneath a motif resembling a heart supported by two leaves or wings. Below these squares is a long horizontal panel, also adorned with elaborate yellowish-gold foliate carvings. The sides of the chest show wood grain patterning with framed rectangular sections, and the structure rests directly on the floor with four straight legs. The background is plain and cream-colored, and the artist's signature is visible in the bottom left corner.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
